posts.author: EbonSkolli
posts.body:
Another common idea out there, but I wanted to make my own in a way that works for me and my current project. This adds a sound effect to dialogue text.
HOW TO USE:
This works the same way as my footstep sound effect plugin. Select the sound effect from the SE folder, then setup the volume, pitch, and frequency values. (Frequency of 1 = every letter/character, frequency of 2 = every other letter/character, etc.)
TERMS OF USE:
Use for commercial or non-commercial projects. Please credit EbonSkolli if you use this plugin.
